Restricted Multifamily · LAMC Title 12

RD4 Zoning
Los Angeles

RD4 — Restricted Density Multiple Dwelling. 1 unit per 1,600 sq ft of lot area under LAMC Title 12. On a 7,500 sq ft lot this allows approximately 4 units by-right, rising to roughly 7 units with a TOC Tier 4 bonus. Typical use: Small apartment buildings, fourplexes.

Free Parcel Zoning Report

Unit Math

lot sq ft ÷ 1,600

Example: 7,500 sq ft lot → 4 units by-right

RD4's 1,600 sq ft/unit makes fourplexes the natural product on standard lots — a configuration lenders underwrite as residential, not commercial.

Simplified by-right calculation per LAMC Title 12. Height district, FAR, setbacks, parking, and overlay zones modify the real envelope — architectural analysis required for a final count. Source: LAMC Title 12 — Zoning Regulations.

TOC Bonus Table — RD4

TOC Tier Density Bonus Affordable Req. Example: 7,500 sq ft lot
Tier 1 +22.5% 8% of units ≈ 4 units
Tier 2 +32.5% 11% of units ≈ 5 units
Tier 3 +50% 15% of units ≈ 6 units
Tier 4 +80% 20% of units ≈ 7 units

TOC tier is parcel-specific — determined by distance to major transit stops. A SevenNova zoning report resolves the exact tier for any address.

Beyond By-Right: Entitlement Pathways

Standard By-Right

6–14 months. No hearing. Full parking. Units capped at base zoning shown above.

TOC By-Right

Ministerial approval near transit with affordable set-aside. Parking reductions included.

ED1 (100% Affordable)

Ministerial fast-track + state density bonus stacking up to +80%. The deepest unit count available without a hearing.
